verdict.rationale: Stagehand's act() lets you drive the page with natural-language instructions instead of selectors, and observe() discovers actionable elements and returns structured actions. A selfHeal option re-infers an action when its recorded selector breaks, and the product handles iframes and shadow DOM automatically using accessibility-tree page understanding. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that actions survive real layout changes — the main resilience claim in community material (comm-8) reads as vendor-voiced rather than an independent test.
